datasets.dataset: C-MAPSS FD001 (train_FD001.csv; real turbofan degradation telemetry, 100 units, 21 sensor channels; the pre-registered informative set ['s4', 's12', 's13', 's15', 's20', 's21'])

custody.license: cc0-1.0 (the dataset card's declared license; NASA C-MAPSS, Saxena et al. 2008 — public domain release)
custody.loader: own (this script parses the raw 26-column CSV: unit, cycle, 3 settings, 21 sensors; no header row per the C-MAPSS release)

period_assumption.basis: TYPED ASSUMPTION (Art. 9): 1 FD001 cycle = 1 flight cycle ~ 6 h; the raw per-cycle alert rate + its CI ride alongside as the assumption-free measurement

adaptive.note: pre-registered BEFORE any coverage number was computed on the full set (the 3-unit probe typed the design, the constants were fixed at that point, then frozen)

fa_budget.period_assumption: TYPED ASSUMPTION (Art. 9): the per-year conversion uses the caller-declared sampling period; the raw alert rate + CI is the assumption-free measurement
fa_budget.guarantee_note: the interval carries coverage >= 1-alpha in distribution; the FA budget is the MEASURED walk-forward alert rate converted at the declared period — the two are typed separately and never conflated

adaptive.note: the adaptive trailing-window scheme quantifies the CURRENT residual population under real degradation drift — the static collapse is the typed expected behavior (the shift leg's live proof), not a defect of the guarantee

datasets.typed_next_lever: the residual adaptive gap (pooled < the declared 0.90) is dominated by the FD001 operational-condition structure (3 operating regimes cause level shifts the trailing window pays for per transition): the typed next lever is settings-CONDITIONED calibration (cluster the calibration window by the 3 declared operating settings before the residual quantile) — pre-registered for the next round, never tuned into this one's numbers

full_per_unit_table.reason: Art. 27: diagnostics commit only when they gate a decision — the decision-gating views (pooled + per-sensor adaptive) are committed; the 600-row per-unit table is RECOMPUTABLE byte-identically from the committed loader + the pre-registered constants (the fetch digest is in custody)
